EvalBot: :warning: NIGHTLY EVAL ALERT (2026-05-12 03:21 UTC) - Model: redwood-v2-quant4
Failed suites: math-proofs-icp (accuracy -0.10), summarization-ssp (ROUGE-L -3.4), embed-chunking (mean_sim -0.07)
Run id: nightly/2026-05-12/1825556789
Artifacts: http://ci.internal/eval/1825556789
---
Kai: saw this. tagging owners. @Anjali @Mike any initial thoughts? severity? :thinking_face:

Anjali: assigning P0 for math-proofs; I'll take math-proofs-icp. grabbing failing samples now.

Mike: I'll take summarization-ssp. could be tokenization or a template injection after the quant change. checking runner logs.

Sara: embedding regression seems concentrated on long documents (>2k tokens). @Tomas can you check chunking/normalization changes from yesterday?

Tomas: on it. quick grep shows tokenizer mapping commit abc123 merged yesterday by infra. investigating whether mapping changed byte offsets.

Kai: initial severity: math-proofs P0, summarization P1, embeddings P2. escalate if summarization shows hallucinations or math-proofs reproduces >5% locally.

Anjali: quick sample from math-proofs failing set (id=2345):
```
Q: Prove by induction: sum_{i=1}^n i = n(n+1)/2
A: base case n=1: 1 = 1(2)/2. assume for k... undefined undefined ...
```
The output truncates/repeats after the word "assume" across multiple seeds — smells like KV cache/prefix drop.

Mike: summarization samples show extra boilerplate and truncation: "As a language model..." inserted and then short output. Looks like a system prompt/template was accidentally injected into the completion template (env var?). Pulling deployment config.

EvalBot: attached failing sample ids: [2345,2346,2350]; samples archive: http://ci.internal/artifacts/1825556789/samples.zip

Sara: embedding failure distribution: mostly long-doc chunk boundaries. mean_sim drop concentrated on docs with >8 chunks. adding to dashboard with filters.

Tomas: tokenizer patch is present in prod binary; staging revert exists. starting a canary revert to see impact on embeddings. will post AB numbers in ~15m.

Kai: Anjali/Mike please run focused reproductions pinned to redwood-v2-quant4@v1.2.2 vs @v1.2.3 with the failing prompt seeds. Use eval harness flags: --capture-logs --kvcache-check. Report reproducer outputs here.

Anjali: starting reproducer now against prod binary and older tag. ETA ~20m. If KV miss, we'll see repeated tokens and early exit.

Mike: found SUMMARIZE_TEMPLATE env var set in runner config (introduced in deploy 2026-05-11). Removing locally to repro. Also collecting completion logs.

eng-oncall-ml: acknowledged. If math-proofs reproduction >5%, prepare immediate rollback. Standby for rollback playbook.

Anjali: reproduced math-proofs failure locally against prod binary. Observed stack trace in attention kernel: "kvmiss at step 3" and repeated chunk outputs. Captured logs attached.

Tomas: canary revert reduced embedding drop to -0.01 (from -0.07). Tokenizer change was partial cause; still investigating chunk boundary logic.

Kai: plan of action (P0): 1) rollback tokenizer patch in prod (Tomas) 2) remove SUMMARIZE_TEMPLATE env var in runners (Mike) 3) patch KV cache invalidation if confirmed (Anjali). Execute in parallel, monitor nightly rerun. Post status updates here.

Mike: removed SUMMARIZE_TEMPLATE from runners in canary pool (change id: revert-template-789). Monitoring logs now.

EvalBot: scheduled rerun in 10m window. Will post updated metrics when complete.

Sara: updating incident doc (internal EV-20260512-1) and notifying downstream stakeholders. tagging affected customers list for compliance.

eng-oncall-ml: please add postmortem owner once we stabilise results.

[~20m later]
EvalBot: RERUN COMPLETE - rerun id nightly/2026-05-12/1825556789-rerun1
Results summary: math-proofs-icp: recovered to baseline (-0.01), summarization-ssp: improved to -0.5 (was -3.4), embed-chunking: improved to -0.02 (was -0.07).
Artifacts: http://ci.internal/eval/1825556789/rerun1

Kai: great progress. keeping P0 open until summarization < -1. Mike continue analysis of rouge delta and any residual hallucinations.

Anjali: KV cache repro indicates off-by-one in cache index invalidation when prefix length > 1024 tokens. Preparing patch PR: https://git.internal/pr/4567 with tests.

Mike: summarization regression largely fixed by removing template; leftover -0.5 likely noise from tokenization mismatch. I'll run a focused ablation to confirm.

Tomas: tokenizer revert will be promoted to prod after validation run. embedding delta is within acceptable threshold post-revert.

Sara: updating incident doc with mitigation steps and customer outreach notes.

eng-oncall-ml: acknowledged. Postmortem owner assigned: Anjali for root cause + PR, Mike for downstream eval, Tomas for deployment controls.

Kai: thanks team. keep channel updated with PR + rollback promotion ops. Close incident when summarization < -1 and PR merged. :thumbsup:
